In 2014 Intel once again topped the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s list of
“green” power purchasers in the U.S., a position we have held since 2008. We also
continue to work toward achieving our ambitious 2020 environmental goals. In 2014,
both our absolute water use and solid waste generated decreased, and although our
chemical waste generated increased, we sent just 5% of that waste to landfill.
